bibl.title: Glass from the Tell Farama / Pelusium excavations, 2003-2006.
bibl.seg: Krystyna Gawlikowska, Glass from the Tell Farama / Pelusium excavations, 2003-2006.
Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/1. Research (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 619-660, figg.
bibl.note: Presents 89 selected glass fragments found during the four seasons of excavation in Pelusium, in and around the theater. They represent mostly tableware and lamps dated from the 1st century to the 7th, but most of the material is from the 5th century or earlier.
